blocks.explanation:
Yeh kitab ke Example 30 (\(\int x e^{ax}\,dx\)) ki seedhi misaal hai, jahan \(a = 2\).
Algebraic \(x\) aur exponential \(e^{2x}\) ka product hai.
ILATE: A pehle, E aakhir mein. Is liye \(x\) first function aur \(e^{2x}\) second.
Plan: ek dafa parts, phir \(\int e^{2x}\,dx\) jo foran aata hai.
steps:
Diya gaya: \(\int x e^{2x}\,dx\).
Maloom karna: indefinite integral.
Tareeqa: integration by parts: \(f(x) = x\), \(g(x) = e^{2x}\).

Parts lagayein
\[= x\cdot\dfrac{e^{2x}}{2} - \int \dfrac{e^{2x}}{2}\cdot 1\,dx\]
Kyun: \(e^{2x}\) ka integral \(\frac{e^{2x}}{2}\) hai (chain rule ka ulta, 2 se divide). \(x\) ka derivative 1.

Dobara integrate karein
\[= \dfrac{xe^{2x}}{2} - \dfrac{1}{2}\cdot\dfrac{e^{2x}}{2} + c\]
\[= \dfrac{xe^{2x}}{2} - \dfrac{e^{2x}}{4} + c\]
Kyun: \(\frac{1}{2}\) constant ko bahar nikala aur phir wohi integral \(\frac{e^{2x}}{2}\) liya. \(\frac{1}{2}\cdot\frac{1}{2} = \frac{1}{4}\).
Dhyan dein: \(\int e^{2x}\,dx\) ko \(e^{2x}\) likh dena (2 se divide na karna) bohat aam ghalti hai.

Tasdeeq
\[\dfrac{d}{dx}\left(\dfrac{xe^{2x}}{2} - \dfrac{e^{2x}}{4}\right)\]
\[= \dfrac{e^{2x}}{2} + xe^{2x} - \dfrac{e^{2x}}{2} = xe^{2x}\]
Kyun: \(xe^{2x}\) par product rule: \(e^{2x} + 2xe^{2x}\), aadha karne par \(\frac{e^{2x}}{2} + xe^{2x}\). \(\frac{e^{2x}}{2}\) cancel; integrand wapas.
